q: What is the difference between standard PLA and PLA+?
a: PLA+ includes proprietary toughness modifiers and impact enhancers. While maintaining the easy-printing, odorless nature of standard PLA, PLA+ offers up to 5x higher impact resistance, better interlayer adhesion, reduced brittleness on the spool, and higher speed capability (up to 500-600 mm/s).

q: Can Water-Washable resin be rinsed straight into domestic sink drains?
a: No, absolutely not. Although water-washable resin rinses clean with plain tap water without requiring isopropyl alcohol (IPA), the rinse water contains uncured photopolymers. It must be exposed to sunlight or UV to fully cure the particulate out, filtered, and then disposed of in accordance with local environmental regulations.

q: How do I choose between 1.75mm and 2.85mm filament?
a: Over 95% of modern desktop 3D printers (including Bambu Lab, Creality, Elegoo, Prusa, Anycubic, Snapmaker) use 1.75mm filament. 2.85mm filament is specifically intended for legacy Ultimaker and industrial dual-feeder setups.
